hero.title: Real-time translated
hero.subtitle: VoxTranslate transcribes, translates and speaks every voice in the room — live. Start a call, pick your language, and just talk. No installs, no waiting.
hero.note: Free starter credits · No credit card · 18+

features.title: Everything you need to be understood
features.subtitle: A complete real-time translation stack — from streaming speech recognition to a spoken translation in the other person's ear.

items.title: Real-time subtitles
items.desc: Every voice is transcribed and translated as it's spoken, then shown as live captions in each listener's own language.

items.title: Four engine tiers
items.desc: Pick the right balance of speed, voice quality and cost — from Standard up to natural AI voices on Premium.

items.title: 84 languages
items.desc: Speak and listen across 84 languages. Source language is auto-detected, or you can set it manually.

items.title: Credit-based billing
items.desc: Pay only for what you use. Start with free credits, top up anytime — no subscriptions, no lock-in.

items.title: Low-latency & private
items.desc: Audio and video flow peer-to-peer over WebRTC. Your media never sits on our servers.

items.title: Browser-native
items.desc: Nothing to install. Open a link, allow your mic and camera, and you're in the conversation.

how.title: Three steps to a multilingual call
how.subtitle: No setup, no plugins. It works the moment you open the room.

steps.title: Choose your language
steps.desc: Set the language you speak and the one you want to hear. Change it anytime during the call.

steps.title: Speak naturally
steps.desc: Talk like you always do. VoxTranslate streams your speech, transcribes it and translates it on the fly.

steps.title: Hear the translation
steps.desc: Everyone reads live subtitles and — on higher tiers — hears a natural spoken translation in their language.

highlights.title: More than a video call
highlights.subtitle: Recording, post-call AI, transcripts in any language — and a place to meet new people.

items.title: Meet new people in public rooms
items.desc: Hop into public rooms and talk with people around the world, across languages — something a normal meeting app will never offer.

items.title: Recording, whiteboard & screen share
items.desc: Record the whole call, share your screen, and brainstorm on a collaborative whiteboard — all included, free.

items.title: Transcripts in any language
items.desc: Download the transcript in the language you choose, free. Add optional AI autocorrection for a polished result (paid).

items.title: Sentiment analysis
items.desc: Get an AI read of the conversation's tone and mood after the call, per participant.

items.title: Reports & email recap
items.desc: Generate an AI session report and email a recap straight to every participant.

tiers.title: Choose your translation engine
tiers.subtitle: Switch engines per call to match the quality, latency and budget you need.

cta.title: Start translating for free today
cta.subtitle: Open a room, share the link, and have your first multilingual conversation in under a minute.
